exposure: Oregon's policy that reduced the state's rate of early (before 39 weeks' gestation) elective (without medical need) births
cohort: Non-Hispanic Black and White women who gave birth in Oregon between 2008-2010 and 2012-2014
finding: A statewide policy reducing early elective births was associated with reduced racial disparities in early elective cesarean delivery, but not early elective induction.
mod_finding: The prepolicy Black-White differences in early elective cesarean (6.1% vs. 4.3%) were eliminated after policy implementation (2.8% vs. 2.5%).
